youtube.title: Why Surgeons Wear Green Scrubs 🏥 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Surgical scrubs are green or blue because of afterimages. After staring at red tissue for long periods, the eyes see a ghostly green-cyan afterimage when they look at a white surface. Green or blue clothing and drapes blend with that afterimage and reduce visual fatigue. Dr. Harry Sherman Brown is credited with introducing green gowns in the early 1900s.
